result:
The correct order is β = 1/α, and none of the three solutions gives it.

For a discrete input, Sibson's α-mutual information is

$$I_\alpha(X;Y)=\frac{\alpha}{\alpha-1}\log\int\Big(\sum_x P(x)\,p(y|x)^\alpha\Big)^{1/\alpha}dy .$$

At high SNR the Gaussian components $p(y|x)$ become well separated. Then $\big(\sum_x P(x)p(y|x)^\alpha\big)^{1/\alpha}\approx\sum_x P(x)^{1/\alpha}p(y|x)$, and integrating over $y$ gives $\sum_x P(x)^{1/\alpha}$. So

$$I_\alpha \to \frac{\alpha}{\alpha-1}\log\sum_x P(x)^{1/\alpha}.$$

The Rényi entropy of order β is $H_\beta=\frac{1}{1-\beta}\log\sum_x P(x)^\beta$. Setting β = 1/α gives the prefactor $\frac{1}{1-1/\alpha}=\frac{\alpha}{\alpha-1}$, which matches the limit above.

The three solutions give:
- Solution 1: β = α, which is wrong.
- Solution 2: β = 1/(1+α), which is wrong.
- Solution 3: β = 1/(1−α), which is wrong.

CHOICE: NONE
